title: Test case 3 — Punch at a railway station: victim's status disputed, thin material (s 18, aged 19)
shows: Where the app reaches its limits: whether the victim was a protected official is disputed, so Category 1 and the minimum non-parole period cannot be decided — the app treats the status as not proved and shows what would change if it were; key facts (prior convictions, background, pre-sentence report) are missing and become stated assumptions; the offender is 19, and version 1 cannot assess a youth justice centre order. Expect a wide band and many cautions.
